paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating (Left: 1e-2, Right: 1e-3). We also include sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The figure illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers, comparing values before and after gating. The X-axis represents the layers ranging from 0 to 22, while the Y-axis indicates the sparsity ratio ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. There are three lines displayed: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, starting near 1.0 and decreasing gradually; an orange dotted line depicting the sparsity ratio after the gate, beginning at about 0.44 and showing fluctuations; and a green dashed line indicating the sparsity ratio after average gating, which remains steady below 0.2 throughout the layers. The lines vary in their trends, emphasizing changes in sparsity across the layers without making explicit comparisons.
model_annotations.Chinese: The figure illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, segmented by gate application status, with layer numbers from 0 to 22 on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer' and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22. The y-axis is labeled 'Sparsity Ratio', also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. Three lines are depicted: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gating with an average of 0.03, showing a gradual decrease from approximately 1.0 at layer 0 to around 0.1 at layer 22; an orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after gating, averaging 0.44, initially starting slightly lower than the blue line and fluctuating around 0.2; and a green dashed line indicating the sparsity ratio after the average gate, averaging 0.33, which decreases steadily and stabilizes towards the end at around 0.1.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, evaluated at a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis represents the 'Layer', displaying a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22. The y-axis denotes the 'Sparsity Ratio', also on a linear scale from 0 to 1. There are three lines depicted in the plot: the blue dashed line labeled 'sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03', which starts at approximately 1.0 at Layer 0 and trends downward to roughly 0.0 by Layer 22, indicating a consistent decline; the orange dotted line labeled 'sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44', which begins at about 0.75 at Layer 0 and shows a decreasing trend to around 0.2 at Layer 22 with minor fluctuations; and the green dash-dot line labeled 'sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33', which starts near 0.1 at Layer 0 and trends downwards to approximately 0.0 at Layer 22, demonstrating a generally decreasing pattern with slight variations.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm veranschaulicht das Verhältnis der Sparsamkeit der SDPA-Ausgabe in Abhängigkeit von der Schicht, mit einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2. Die x-Achse ist als 'Layer' beschriftet und hat einen linearen Skalierungstyp mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 22. Die y-Achse ist als 'Sparsity Ratio' beschriftet, ebenfalls mit einer linearen Skala, und reicht von 0 bis 1. Es sind drei Linien in dem Diagramm dargestellt: die blaue Linie (gestrichelt) repräsentiert das Verhältnis der Sparsamkeit vor dem Gate mit einem durchschnittlichen Wert von 0,03, beginnt bei etwa 1,0 und zeigt einen stetigen Rückgang bis etwa 0,1. Die orange Linie (punktiert) zeigt das Verhältnis der Sparsamkeit nach dem Gate mit einem Durchschnittswert von 0,44; sie startet bei knapp unter 1,0 und weist unregelmäßige Schwankungen auf, bevor sie schließlich bei etwa 0,4 endet. Die grüne Linie (durchgezogen) repräsentiert das Verhältnis der Sparsamkeit nach dem Durchschnittsgate mit einem Durchschnittswert von 0,33, ebenfalls beginnend bei etwa 1,0 mit einem gleichmäßigen Rückgang und einer Endstellung bei etwa 0,1.
